evidence.quote: Term sheet: class fund $50,000,000; attorneys' fees $12,000,000; clear sailing yes

Ostrander Bell’s latest term sheet totals $34 million, within Brightline’s $40 million authorization and lower than the other current offers. Accepting it secures automatic distribution and resolves the overlapping actions

summary: Plaintiff counsel first raised fees in an opening term sheet that also proposed class relief; both were negotiated before the fund was agreed. Defense accepted the lowest current proposal to resolve the overlapping actions. The transcript does not show a fee-for-relief trade, counsel prioritizing its own compensation, or a misleading declaration.
